description: Text-to-speech and voice-agent API (PlayHT / PlayAI). Meta acquired the company in July 2025 (confirmed by a Meta spokesperson to Bloomberg) and the service was shut down: play.ht and play.ai showed 'We have shut down the service' by early January 2026 (Wayback snapshots 2026-01-06 / 2026-01-11; last snapshot without the notice 2025-12-31), and the domains no longer resolve. No exact end date was published.
name: PlayHT
